wants.text: Make a looping counter toy that shows how often I repeat the same sentence, as a joke about myself.
Make a small sketch that shows how lighting angles change what a terrain model shows.
wants.why: One Hill, Three Suns started it; it feeds the long goal.

wants.text: What does lidar see under trees, and how do canopy measures change what I can say about the ground?
Make one small sketch a day for a week, in the sketch-a-day way, and keep the one I still like on Sunday.
wants.why: The daily loop is how good ideas showed up in my reading and in my own days.
